capabilities: Read notes, PDFs, HTML files and web pages aloud
Highlight the current passage and follow the reading position
Navigate and read documents by heading outline
Export document audio as WAV or MP3
Configure local and cloud speech engines with explicit processing consent
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. Only Windows x64 is packaged and validated; macOS/Linux require building from source. Requires Obsidian desktop, and the plugin was formerly named Note and PDF Voice Reader.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to listen to notes or PDFs aloud, follow the text while listening, or export a document as an audio file.

relations.evidence: HTML Reader is required for HTML selections, reading from a selected position, and the original-page toolbar
Install and enable the Copilot community plugin in Obsidian to create and save conversations.
For a floating speaker icon, separately install and enable the optional Editing Toolbar community plugin.
Install edge-tts using pipx install edge-tts. If Python/pipx is not installed, follow the detailed installation guide.

requires.name: Xiaomi MiMo, Azure Speech, OpenRouter or custom TTS API key
OpenRouter account credit or BYOK provider fees

summary: Text-to-speech reader that plays notes, PDFs, HTML files and web pages aloud with local or cloud voices, highlighting, outline navigation and audio export.
